messages.subject: unmarked version 0.10.2 - Please update!
parts:
Hi everyone,

A recent change in the package 'RcppArmadillo' caused some serious problems in 'unmarked'. I just released a new version of unmarked that appears to have resolved these issues, and I highly recommend that everyone update both packages and rerun any models that may have been used older versions of unmarked AND either versions 0.3.900.0 or 0.3.900.7 of RcppArmadillo. If you have successfully updated both packages, you should get the following:

> packageVersion("unmarked")
[1] ‘0.10.2’
> packageVersion("RcppArmadillo")
[1] ‘0.3.900.7’

I apologize for any inconvenience.

Richard
